main_text.p: verbis doctrinam de gratia Dei è scripturis & patribus traditam plane subuertit.

Bonaventura Aquinati σύν[?] ξεον&[?] λόγε[?] aliter docuit, de merito enim sic habet. {a}Gratiam iam habitam, per gratiae usum non contingit mereri, nec quantum ad meritum congrui nec quantum ad meritum condigni. De gratia vero sic disputat, ut vix reperias[?] inter Scholasticos quenquam qui magis illustret hanc doctrinam, nam sic scribit: {b}Gratia respectu principii à quo, diuiditur in gratiam praedestinationis, vocationis, sufficatio-nis, & magnificationis, primo enim Deus gratiam proposuit, secundo offert, tertio confert, quarto complet. Itemque sic subiicit: ut comparatur ad effectum, diuiditur, in praevenientem, & subsequentem, siue operantem, & cooperantem. Quum itaque P. Lumbardus gratiam definiuisset virtutem, Bonaventura non sequitur magistrum, tanquam seruum pecus, sicut plerique solebant, sed tanquam grauis censor {c}Dicendum, inquit, quod Magister (vbi dicit gratiam esse virtutem) non intendit in illo verbo notificare gratiam gratum facientem, quantum ad suam essentiam, sed quasi per posterius & quodammodo per effectus, quia in illos actus non exit gratia, nisi mediantibus habitibus virtutum, videlicet fidei, & charitatis, ideo notificans gratiam, dicit quod gratia nihil aliud sit quam fides cum dilectione, pro eo, quod per illos habitus dicitur gratia in actum exire, per quos innotescit nobis quo loco plura in hanc sententiam habet Bonaventura. Et quamvis nonnunquam ex seculi sui tenebris loquitur[?], tamen plura, & meliora

pau[?] apes[?] qui[?] con[?] cilio[?] con[?] enim[?] debe[?] tur. Cle[?] pars[?] conf[?] pac[?] ferm[?] pro[?] Cle[?] tis C[?] imm[?] tem[?] info[?] prob[?] mod[?] dem[?] dam[?] ( dor[?] qui[?] con[?] con[?] san[?] der[?] &u[?]

page.notes: <note letter="a" side="left">Lib.2.d.17. art.2.q.1.</note> <note letter="b" side="left">Ibid. dist.2.6. art.1. dub.1.</note> <note letter="c" side="left">Lib.2.d.26. dub.2.</note> Left margin notes printed as above; the note letter "b" reading "dist.2.6." is doubtful. The Greek phrase after "Bonaventura Aquinati" is blurred and only partly legible (σύν, ξεον, λόγε marked [?]). The page is heavily stained, especially in the centre and lower lines, so words such as "reperias", "loquitur" and "tenebris" are uncertain. The right-hand page is cropped at the scan edge: only word fragments are visible, transcribed as a single paragraph of fragments, all doubtful. The word "paucis" at the lower right is treated as a catchword. Printed "vix" and "praevenientem" were normalised to v as a consonant; "sufficatio-nis" carries the printed hyphen. The printed "sufficatio" is probably a misprint for "sanctificatio" and is left as printed.
